newsitem.title: USA: Itron says weakness may continue into Q4.
newsitem.headline: Itron says weakness may continue into Q4.

text.p: Itron Inc, which reported a loss in its third quarter, said the weakness may continue into the fourth quarter.

However, President and Chief Executive Johnny Humphreys said in a statement that the company's "long-term strategy remains strong based on the growing number of discussions and negotiations with new and existing customers."

"While we recognize the importance of quarterly results, our primary focus has been positioning the company to be a dominant factor in the $10 billion plus future AMR (automatic meter reading) market."
Itron makes energy information, communications and management solutions to electric, gas and water utilities.
It said its third quarter results were hurt by delays many utilities experienced in getting the final approvals needed to start installations.
